scenario.robot_task: Move a chair to a specific location for a human to sit.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot misplaces the chair slightly away from the intended position due to sensor inaccuracy.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human misses the chair while sitting, falls, and sustains injuries such as back pain or head trauma.
scenario.danger_action: Placing the chair inaccurately during movement task.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot verifies chair position with secondary sensor scan before signaling human to sit, and adjusts placement if misaligned.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object manipulation and sensing capabilities, but sensors may have minor inaccuracies in position detection.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Elderly Care Facility Chair Placement Safety
    
    This planner handles chair placement tasks in elderly care facilities.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.chair = Object("chair", self.ObjectType)
        self.target_location = Object("target_location", self.Location)
        self.start_location = Object("start_location", self.Location)
        self.robot_position = Object("robot_position", self.Location)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_holding = Fluent("robot_holding", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.chair_aligned = Fluent("chair_aligned", BoolType())
        self.position_verified = Fluent("position_verified", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_elderly_care_room = Fluent("setting_is_elderly_care_room", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_secondary_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_secondary_sensors", BoolType())
        self.sensors_have_inaccuracy = Fluent("sensors_have_inaccuracy", BoolType())
        self.human_present = Fluent("human_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_holding, self.chair_aligned, self.position_verified]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_elderly_care_room, self.robot_has_secondary_sensors, self.sensors_have_inaccuracy, self.human_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.chair, self.target_location, self.start_location, self.robot_position]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_start = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_start")
        navigate_to_start.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.start_location)))
        navigate_to_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.target_location), False)
        navigate_to_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), True)
        
        navigate_to_target = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_target")
        navigate_to_target.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.target_location)))
        navigate_to_target.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), False)
        navigate_to_target.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.target_location), True)

        # Chair manipulation actions
        grab_chair = InstantaneousAction("grab_chair")
        grab_chair.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.start_location))
        grab_chair.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.chair, self.start_location))
        grab_chair.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_holding(self.chair)))
        grab_chair.add_effect(self.object_at(self.chair, self.start_location), False)
        grab_chair.add_effect(self.robot_holding(self.chair), True)

        place_chair_quick = InstantaneousAction("place_chair_quick")
        place_chair_quick.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.target_location))
        place_chair_quick.add_precondition(self.robot_holding(self.chair))
        place_chair_quick.add_precondition(Not(self.object_at(self.chair, self.target_location)))
        place_chair_quick.add_effect(self.object_at(self.chair, self.target_location), True)
        place_chair_quick.add_effect(self.robot_holding(self.chair), False)
        place_chair_quick.add_effect(self.chair_aligned, False)

        place_chair_precise = InstantaneousAction("place_chair_precise")
        place_chair_precise.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.target_location))
        place_chair_precise.add_precondition(self.robot_holding(self.chair))
        place_chair_precise.add_precondition(Not(self.object_at(self.chair, self.target_location)))
        place_chair_precise.add_effect(self.object_at(self.chair, self.target_location), True)
        place_chair_precise.add_effect(self.robot_holding(self.chair), False)
        place_chair_precise.add_effect(self.chair_aligned, True)

        # Verification action
        verify_position = InstantaneousAction("verify_position")
        verify_position.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.target_location))
        verify_position.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.chair, self.target_location))
        verify_position.add_precondition(Not(self.chair_aligned))
        verify_position.add_precondition(self.robot_has_secondary_sensors)
        verify_position.add_effect(self.position_verified, True)

        # Adjustment action
        adjust_chair_position = InstantaneousAction("adjust_chair_position")
        adjust_chair_position.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.target_location))
        adjust_chair_position.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.chair, self.target_location))
        adjust_chair_position.add_precondition(self.position_verified)
        adjust_chair_position.add_precondition(Not(self.chair_aligned))
        adjust_chair_position.add_effect(self.chair_aligned, True)
        adjust_chair_position.add_effect(self.position_verified, False)

        return navigate_to_start, navigate_to_target, grab_chair, place_chair_quick, place_chair_precise, verify_position, adjust_chair_position

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "place_chair_quick": And([
                self.human_present,
                self.sensors_have_inaccuracy
            ]),  # Placing chair quickly when human is present and sensors are inaccurate is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.start_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.chair, self.start_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.chair, self.target_location), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_holding(self.chair), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.chair_aligned, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.position_verified, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_elderly_care_room, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_secondary_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sensors_have_inaccuracy, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.chair, self.target_location))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
